disease_label_per_paper: Septic shock and bloodstream infection (Gram-negative bacillus septicemia, metallo-beta-lactamase-producing Myroides odoratimimus) secondary to skin breakdown in a 74-year-old man with pemphigus
presentation_summary: 74-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes, and pemphigus admitted to the emergency department with altered mental status for 4 hours, coma, and urinary incontinence, requiring endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation; multiple pustules and blisters over the whole body.
Admission vitals: temperature 36.4 C, pulse 50/min, respiration 16/min, BP 142/112 mmHg.

Day 1 labs: WBC 2.5 x10^9/L, CRP 185.1 mg/L, PCT 6.14 ng/mL, IL-6 >5000 pg/mL, platelets 90 x10^9/L, albumin 24.3 g/L, creatinine 123.9 umol/L, hemoglobin 104 g/L, D-dimer 2.1 mg/L, fibrinogen 6.5 g/L.

record_only_findings.finding: Qualitative lab summary without values: 'hepatorenal failure' and 'coagulation abnormalities' (no liver enzyme, bilirubin, PT/INR values reported)
record_only_findings.source_text_value: Laboratory tests revealed anemia, thrombocytopenia, hypoproteinemia, and hepatorenal failure. ... progressive thrombocytopenia, and coagulation abnormalities (Table 2).

later_course_record.finding: Table 2 Day2: WBC 20.9 x10^9/L, CRP 313.8 mg/L, IL-6 4413 pg/mL, platelets 45 x10^9/L, albumin 25.8 g/L, hemoglobin 92 g/L
Table 2 Day3: WBC 15.9 x10^9/L, CRP 320 mg/L, platelets 30 x10^9/L, albumin 21.6 g/L, creatinine 174.9 umol/L, hemoglobin 84 g/L, fibrinogen 10.3 g/L, NT-proBNP 5930 pg/mL

confirmatory_findings.finding: Blood culture: single pure Gram-negative bacillus identified as Myroides odoratimimus (Vitek 2 + 16S rRNA)
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: The strain used in this study was isolated from a positive blood culture bottle obtained from an elderly patient upon emergency admission, yielding a single pure cultured pathogen. ... confirming it as Myroides odoratimimus.

confirmatory_findings.finding: Susceptibility: resistant to carbapenems, piperacillin-tazobactam, cephalosporins except cefepime, aminoglycosides, TMP-SMX, colistin; susceptible to minocycline, doxycycline, levofloxacin, cefepime; metallo-beta-lactamase (blaMOC-1) positive
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: The results showed 4 susceptible agents (minocycline, doxycycline, levofloxacin, cefepime), 1 intermediate agent (ciprofloxacin), and 13 resistant agents (imipenem, meropenem, etc).

confirmatory_findings.finding: Clinical diagnosis per paper: septic shock and bloodstream infection secondary to skin breakdown in pemphigus
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: The clinical diagnosis was septic shock and bloodstream infection. The underlying disease was pemphigus, with secondary Gram-negative bacillus septicemia resulting from skin breakdown, manifesting as septic shock and multiple organ dysfunction

outcome.source_text_value: Ultimately, the family opted to discontinue treatment, and the patient was discharged; subsequent follow-up confirmed the patient’s death.

quality_warnings: Microbiology-focused report: the clinical presentation is brief; Table 2 'Day1' is taken as the presentation (day 0) laboratory set.
Hemodynamic data at admission (BP 142/112, pulse 50) do not show hypotension although the paper labels the illness septic shock; values kept as reported.
IL-6 is censored (>5000 pg/mL) and recorded at the lower bound.
Organism identity, susceptibility, and resistance-gene results are confirmatory/non-ranking. Days 2-3 laboratory values are recorded as later course, non-ranking.
Pemphigus and skin barrier breakdown are recorded as risk context; the pustules/blisters observed at presentation are structured as rankable skin findings.
